lead: A proof that holds thousands of open handles under `Core\IO::temporaryDir()` is slow on the Windows dev host, and the slowness is not Novis.
body: 20000 unclosed `Core\IO::open` handles on one file in the host's temporary folder took 7 s and grew with the square of the count, while the same loop on a file under `.agent-tmp/` took 0.28 s and raw `CreateFileW` took 0.13 s. Keep a many-handles attack near 10000, which is still far past a Linux descriptor limit, and time a slow case against a file inside the tree before blaming the runtime.
